displayName: Nightdocs — Office Viewer & Diff for Word, Excel & PowerPoint
description: View Word, Excel and PowerPoint (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) and Markdown files in dark mode and diff versions side by side, straight from Git. Markdown front matter for AI agents, skills and rules. Fast, private and view-only.
config.markdown.compareRendered: Show comparisons of Markdown files, such as changes in Source Control, rendered in Nightdocs instead of as text. **Edit** in the viewer switches a comparison back to text.
config.markdown.showOnlineContent: Show the pictures of Markdown files that come from the web, such as badges, without asking. When off, a file with such pictures offers **Show Online Content**. Loading them lets the sites they come from see that the file was opened.
